title: Skill Centre Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Skill Centre Coordinator / Centre Manager – Skill Development Project

**Location:** CTM / Navrangpura, Ahmedabad Gujarat (Centre-specific location to be confirmed)

**Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and organised Skill Centre Coordinator to manage the day-to-day operations of a skill training centre under the Namo Gujarat Kaushalya and Rojgar Mission / Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM) or other applicable government skill development programmes.

The candidate will be responsible for centre administration, candidate enrolment, documentation, batch coordination, training operations, compliance and reporting in accordance with the applicable scheme guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the daily operations and administration of the skill training centre.
* Coordinate candidate mobilisation activities with Community Mobilizers to achieve approved enrolment targets.
* Verify candidate eligibility and documentation as per applicable GSDM scheme guidelines and approved job-role criteria.
* Facilitate candidate registration and enrolment through the designated portal or approved registration system.
* Maintain candidate records, application forms, supporting documents and enrolment trackers.
* Coordinate batch formation, training schedules, trainer availability and training material requirements.
* Monitor daily trainee attendance, absenteeism and dropout risks, and coordinate timely follow-up.
* Ensure the centre is adequately equipped and ready for training delivery.
* Maintain records of training sessions, attendance, assessments, certification and placement activities, as applicable.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly progress reports for management.
* Coordinate with trainers, Skill Training Partners, project management teams and authorised government representatives.
* Ensure readiness for inspections, audits and monitoring visits.
* Identify operational issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain data accuracy, confidentiality and compliance with applicable project guidelines.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Graduate in any discipline; qualifications in Business Administration, Social Work, Human Resources or Education will be preferred.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in skill development, vocational training, educational administration or training centre operations.
* Experience in government-funded skill development projects will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, email and online registration systems.
* Good communication skills in Gujarati and Hindi; working knowledge of English is desirable.
* Strong organisational, coordination, documentation and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities and work towards enrolment and operational targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience working with government skill development schemes or training partners.
* Familiarity with candidate enrolment, eligibility verification, attendance management and training documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to transparent, compliant operations.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with field teams and training staff.

Key Performance Expectations

* Achievement of approved centre enrolment targets within stipulated timelines.
* Accurate and complete candidate documentation.
* Timely batch commencement and training coordination.
* Timely reporting and maintenance of centre records.
* Compliance with applicable scheme guidelines and project requirements.

**Keywords:** Skill Development, Training Centre Coordinator, GSDM, Vocational Training, Candidate Enrolment, Centre Operations, Government Projects, Training Administration.

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Operations Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and client-focused Operations Manager to oversee client account management and lead a team of Client Success Managers (CSMs). The role involves managing a portfolio of approximately 25–30 client accounts, ensuring strong client relationships, maintaining service quality, and driving operational excellence.

The ideal candidate will work closely with CSMs to develop and execute client strategies, resolve escalations, monitor account performance, and ensure consistent delivery aligned with client expectations. This role requires strong leadership, excellent English communication, and the ability to take ownership of both client outcomes and team performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management**

* Oversee a portfolio of 25–30 client accounts, ensuring client satisfaction, service quality, and long-term relationship growth.
* Work closely with CSMs to understand client requirements, develop account-specific strategies, and proactively address client needs.
* Monitor account health, client feedback, service delivery, and potential retention risks.
* Handle complex client concerns, escalations, and service-related challenges effectively.
* Identify opportunities to improve client experience, strengthen relationships, and enhance account performance.

**Team Management and Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and support the CSM team to achieve client management and operational goals.
* Set clear expectations, monitor performance, and ensure accountability across the team.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews to identify development needs and improve team effectiveness.
* Guide CSMs in client communication, expectation management, problem-solving, and strategic account planning.
* Foster a collaborative, ownership-driven, and client-first work culture.

**Client Strategy and Performance Management**

* Collaborate with CSMs to develop and implement client-specific strategies and action plans.
* Review account performance, service delivery metrics, client feedback, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Identify recurring issues, operational gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure timely follow-ups on client action items, commitments, and deliverables.
* Use performance insights and client feedback to drive continuous improvement and client retention.

**Operational Excellence**

* Establish and maintain structured processes for account tracking, reporting, escalation management, and follow-ups.
* Ensure accurate documentation of client interactions, account updates, and action plans.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational challenges and maintain smooth service delivery.
* Anticipate potential risks and take preventive action rather than waiting for issues to escalate.
* Share regular updates on account health, team performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives with senior management.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 4-5 years of relevant experience in operations management, client relationship management, account management, or client success.
* Prior experience managing a team, preferably a team of Client Success Managers or client-facing professionals.
* Proven experience handling multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with international clients.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving, risk identification, and issue resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor KPIs, evaluate performance, and make data-driven decisions.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and maintain high standards of execution.
* Strong ownership, decision-making, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with US-based clients or international service delivery teams.
* Experience in virtual assistant services, BPO, outsourcing, client success, or a similar service-based business.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, project management tools, client reporting, and performance dashboards.
* Experience managing client escalations, retention, service quality, and account-level performance.

Pay: Up to ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Prahlad Nagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Are you available to join immediately?
* Are you comfortable with the mentioned compensation?

Experience:

* Team management: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

title: Facility Manager
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Department:** Administration & Facilities

**About Simform**

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market.

Simform is well-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow. Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Facility Manager to oversee the end-to-end management of office facilities and workplace operations across our IT offices. The role will be responsible for ensuring a safe, efficient, compliant, and employee-friendly work environment while managing vendors, infrastructure, security, transport, housekeeping, cafeteria services, and office maintenance.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in corporate facility management, vendor governance, workplace services, budget management, and employee engagement initiatives within an IT/ITES environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Facility Operations Management**

* Manage day-to-day facility operations across office locations.

* Ensure uninterrupted functioning of all building infrastructure, utilities, and workplace services.

* Monitor and maintain HVAC systems, electrical systems, DG sets, UPS, plumbing, lighting, and other critical assets.

* Implement preventive and corrective maintenance schedules.

**Workplace Experience & Employee Services**

* Ensure a clean, safe, and productive workplace environment.

* Manage employee seating, workspace allocation, meeting rooms, and office moves.

* Drive workplace improvement initiatives to enhance employee experience.

* Address employee facility-related concerns and ensure timely resolution.

**Vendor & Contract Management**

* Manage housekeeping, security, transport, cafeteria, pest control, maintenance, and other facility vendors.

* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and KPIs.

* Negotiate contracts, renewals, and cost-effective service agreements.

* Conduct regular vendor reviews and audits.

**Security & Access Management**

* Oversee physical security operations and visitor management systems.

* Manage access control systems, ID cards, and surveillance systems.

* Ensure compliance with organizational security protocols and policies.

* Coordinate with security agencies for smooth operations.

**Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with local statutory regulations and corporate standards.

* Manage fire safety systems, emergency response procedures, and evacuation drills.

* Conduct workplace safety inspections and risk assessments.

* Coordinate statutory inspections and certifications.

**Transport & Cafeteria Management**

* Manage employee transportation services and vendor coordination.

* Ensure smooth cafeteria operations and maintain hygiene standards.

* Monitor employee satisfaction and service quality.

**Space Planning & Infrastructure Projects**

* Plan office layouts, expansions, relocations, and workspace optimization initiatives.

* Coordinate office renovation and infrastructure projects.

* Work closely with business stakeholders to support growth and operational requirements.

**Budget & Cost Management**

* Prepare annual facility budgets and monitor expenses.

* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality.

* Manage purchase requests, facility-related procurement, and asset utilization.

**Business Continuity & Emergency Management**

* Support business continuity planning and workplace readiness.

* Ensure critical facility systems are operational and adequately backed up.

* Lead response during facility-related emergencies and incidents.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Facility Management, Business Administration, or related field.

* Certification in Facility Management, Safety, NEBOSH, IOSH, or Project Management will be an advantage.

### **Experience**

* 6–12 years of experience in Facility Management within IT/ITES, Technology, or Corporate Office environments.

* Experience managing facilities for offices with 500+ employees preferred.

* Proven experience handling multiple vendors and facility budgets.

### **Required Skills**

* Corporate Facility Management

* Vendor & Contract Management

* Workplace Operations

* Security & Access Control Management

* Health, Safety & Compliance

* Space Planning & Workplace Strategy

* Budgeting & Cost Optimization

* Project Management

* Stakeholder Management

* MS Office & Facility Management Systems

### **Key Competencies**

* Leadership & Team Management

* Problem Solving & Decision Making

* Customer/Employee-Centric Approach

* Attention to Detail

* Negotiation & Influencing Skills

* Planning & Execution

* Crisis & Incident Management

### **Preferred Industry**

* IT Services

* IT Product Companies

* Global Capability Centers (GCCs)

* BPO/KPO

* Shared Services Organizations

### **Success Metrics**

* Facility Uptime & Operational Efficiency

* Vendor SLA Adherence

* Employee Satisfaction Scores

* Compliance Audit Results

* Cost Optimization Achievements

* Workplace Safety Performance

* Timely Project Completion

### **Why Join Us**

* Young Team, Thriving Culture

* Flat-hierarchical, friendly, engineering-oriented, and growth-focused culture.

* Well-balanced learning and growth opportunities

* Free health insurance.

* Office facilities with a game zone, in-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.

title: Assistant Manager - Operations
description:
Job Description:

**Company:** Vendiman  
**Industry:** Retail / Vending Machine Operations  
**Job Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years  
**Department:** Operations

About the Role

Vendiman is looking for an **Assistant Manager – Operations** to manage and coordinate day\-to\-day vending machine operations across assigned locations. The role will focus on ensuring smooth operations, machine uptime, inventory availability, field\-team coordination, and achievement of operational and business targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage **day\-to\-day operations of vending machines** across assigned locations.
* Ensure machines are operational, adequately stocked, and maintained as per company standards.
* Monitor **machine\-wise and location\-wise sales, performance, uptime, and operational issues**.
* Coordinate with field teams, technicians, warehouse, sales, and other internal teams for smooth operations.
* Plan and monitor **refilling, replenishment, servicing, and preventive maintenance** activities.
* Track machine breakdowns, downtime, complaints, and ensure timely resolution within defined TAT.
* Monitor inventory and stock movement to ensure **product availability at vending machines**.
* Maintain operational reports and review performance against defined targets.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency and machine performance.
* Conduct regular checks/audits of vending machines and ensure adherence to company processes.
* Handle escalations from clients, locations, and internal stakeholders related to vending machine operations.
* Support onboarding and operational setup of **new vending machine locations**.
* Coordinate with vendors and service partners wherever required.
* Prepare and share **daily, weekly, and monthly operational updates** with management.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, safety standards, and operational guidelines.
* Train and guide field/operations team members to ensure effective execution.
* Support management in achieving **sales, availability, uptime, and operational efficiency targets**.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Minimum **2 years of experience** in Operations, preferably in **Retail, Vending Machines, FMCG, QSR, Logistics, or a similar industry**.
* Good understanding of **field operations and team coordination**.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets** and operational reporting.
* Ability to monitor and manage multiple locations simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned city/locations as required.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and target\-oriented environment.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* Vending machine **uptime and availability**
* Machine\-wise and location\-wise **sales performance**
* Timely refilling and replenishment
* Breakdown and complaint **resolution TAT**
* Inventory availability and accuracy
* Field\-team productivity
* Client/location satisfaction
* Compliance with operational SOPs
* Reduction of operational losses and inefficiencies

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **hands\-on, proactive, and result\-oriented**, with strong field\-operations and team\-coordination skills. The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple vending machine locations and solving operational issues on the ground.

**Job Locations: Ahmedabad\| Experience: 2\+ Years \| Industry: Retail / Vending Machine Operations**

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Gift City Branch - Market Operations Lead, Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join JPMorganChase's India GIFT City buildout and lead a front\-line operations team at the center of trade lifecycle delivery. You will manage complex post\-trade processes across multiple markets products, strengthen controls, and drive automation and process improvements. This is a high\-visibility role for an experienced operations leader who can deliver results under pressure, develop talent, and partner effectively across trading, technology, risk, and compliance.  

  

As a Vice President Market Operations based in the GIFT City branch (Ahmedabad), you will lead a highly visible operations function responsible for end\-to\-end post‑trade delivery. You will own service delivery, controls, and regulatory compliance across products including foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, and money markets. Reporting to the India Branch Head of Operations, you will lead a team, drive measurable improvements in efficiency and straight\-through processing, and partner closely with the front office and key control functions to deliver stable, well\-controlled operations.

 **Job responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end post\-trade delivery, including trade capture and validation, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, break management, investigations, and issue resolution.
* Own service performance outcomes, improving accuracy, timeliness, straight\-through processing, and client experience.
* Strengthen the risk and control environment through disciplined control execution, issue management, remediation, and audit readiness.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies, maintaining strong governance, documentation, and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach, and develop the team, ensuring clear accountability, effective coverage, and operational resiliency.
* Partner with sales and trading, technology, risk, compliance, and finance teams to resolve exceptions and deliver change effectively.
* Drive automation and process improvements, including workflow redesign, data quality enhancements, and operational dashboards.
* Provide clear reporting on key performance indicators, incidents, control issues, and change delivery progress.

 **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 15 years of experience in markets operations, post\-trade, middle office, or trade support, with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership across at least one of: foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, or money markets.
* Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and building a strong controls culture.
* Strong knowledge of post\-trade processes, including confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, and investigations.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements, such as reduced breaks, faster turnaround times, higher straight\-through processing, or automation benefits.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data and key performance indicators to manage performance and prioritize risk.  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience working in a regulated markets environment, with familiarity with India and emerging markets operating considerations.
* Experience leading change or transformation initiatives in operations in partnership with technology teams.
* Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI\-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to improve operational efficiency and accuracy, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, well\-controlled execution through coaching, change adoption, and continuous improvement
